name: Astra
description: Ghanaian Agent Astra harnesses the energies of the cosmos to reshape battlefields to her whim. With full command of her astral form and a talent for deep strategic foresight, she's always eons ahead of her enemy's next move.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Nova Pulse
abilities.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to detonate it, <debuffred>concussing</> all players hit.

abilities.name: Nebula
abilities.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to transform it into a smoke.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to create a zone that <debuffred>pulls</> all players to the center, exploding and applying <debuffred>vulnerable</> to all players.

abilities.name: Cosmic Divide
abilities.description: ENTER <whitebold>Astral Form</>. ALT FIRE to EQUIP <whitebold>Cosmic Divide</>. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to create an indestructible wall that blocks audio.

abilities.name: Astral Form
abilities.description:
ACTIVATE ULTIMATE to ENTER <whitebold>Astral Form</>. FIRE to cast <whitebold>Stars</>. 

INTERACT to recall a <whitebold>Star</>. Recalling a <whitebold>Star</> forms a brief smoke.

name: Breach
description: The bionic Swede Breach fires powerful, targeted kinetic blasts to aggressively clear a path through enemy ground. The damage and disruption he inflicts ensures no fight is ever fair.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Flashpoint
abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Flashpoint</>. FIRE to send it through a wall, exploding to <debuffred>flash</> all players looking at it.

abilities.name: Fault Line
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Fault Line</>. HOLD FIRE to increase distance. RELEASE to detonate a zone that <debuffred>concusses</> all players.

abilities.name: Aftershock
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Aftershock</>. FIRE to send a zone through a wall, exploding to repeatedly deal <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Rolling Thunder</>. FIRE to send forward a wave that <debuffred>concusses</> and <debuffred>knocks up</> all players.

name: Brimstone
description: Joining from the U.S.A., Brimstone's orbital arsenal ensures his squad always has the advantage. His ability to deliver utility precisely and safely make him the unmatched boots-on-the-ground commander.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Stim Beacon
abilities.description: INSTANTLY throw a <whitebold>Stim Beacon</>. On landing, create a zone that grants <teal>combat stim</> and <teal>haste</> to allies.

abilities.name: Incendiary
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Incendiary</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

abilities.name: Sky Smoke
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

abilities.name: Orbital Strike
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to cast an <whitebold>Orbital Strike</> at a location, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> over time to all players.

name: Chamber
description: Well-dressed and well-armed, French weapons designer Chamber expels aggressors with deadly precision. He leverages his custom arsenal to hold the line and pick off enemies from afar, with a contingency built for every plan.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Rendezvous
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Rendezvous</>. FIRE to place. While in range, REACTIVATE to instantly teleport to it.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Trademark
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trademark</>. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, creating a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Headhunter
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Headhunter</>. FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights.

abilities.name: Tour De Force
abilities.description:
ACTIVATE to access a sniper rifle that deals <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the upper body.

FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights. On kills, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players.

name: Clove
description: Scottish troublemaker Clove makes mischief for enemies in both the heat of combat and the cold of death. The young immortal keeps foes guessing, even from beyond the grave, their return to the living only ever a moment away.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Pick-me-up
abilities.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy that you damaged or killed to gain <teal>haste</> and <teal>overheal</>.

abilities.name: Ruse
abilities.description:
EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

While dead, Clove can access <whitebold>Ruse</> to cast brief smokes.

abilities.name: Not Dead Yet
abilities.description: On death, ACTIVATE to channel a <teal>self-resurrect</>. During the channel, Clove is <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to end the channel early. Once resurrected, secure a kill or damaging assist to stay alive.

abilities.name: Meddle
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Meddle</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>decaying</> all players.

name: Cypher
description: The Moroccan information broker, Cypher is a one-man surveillance network who keeps tabs on the enemy's every move. No secret is safe. No maneuver goes unseen. Cypher is always watching.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Cyber Cage
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY throw a <whitebold>Cyber Cage</>. INTERACT to create a vision-blocking cylinder that plays an audio cue when enemies come in contact.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Spycam
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Spycam</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Spycam</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. REACTIVATE to control it. FIRE to shoot a dart that <debuffred>snapshots</> enemies hit until they remove it.

Can be picked up.

abilities.name: Trapwire
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trapwire</>. FIRE to place a wire between surfaces. <whitebold>Trapwire</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers when enemies come in contact, <debuffred>tethering</> enemies, and after a delay, <debuffred>revealing</> them if <whitebold>Trapwire</> is not destroyed.

Can be picked up.

abilities.name: Neural Theft
abilities.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy. After a delay, <debuffred>snapshot</> living enemies twice.

name: Deadlock
description: Norwegian operative Deadlock deploys an array of cutting-edge nanowire to secure the battlefield from even the most lethal assault. No one escapes her vigilant watch, nor survives her unyielding ferocity.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Sonic Sensor
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Sonic Sensor</>. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby detected enemy noise, creating a zone that <debuffred>concusses</> all players. <whitebold>Sonic Sensor</> <teal>stealths</> after placement.

Can be picked up.

abilities.name: Barrier Mesh
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Barrier Mesh</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create destructible markers that fortify after a delay. These markers form barriers that block player movement.

abilities.name: GravNet
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>GravNet</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, forcing all players to <debuffred>crouch</> and move <debuffred>slowly</> until they remove the net.

abilities.name: Annihilation
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Annihilation</>. FIRE to launch a zone, forcing the first enemy caught into a destructible cocoon that pulls them along a path for <debuffred>lethal damage</> unless the cocoon is destroyed.

name: Fade
description: Turkish bounty hunter Fade unleashes the power of raw nightmare to seize enemy secrets. Attuned with terror itself, she hunts down targets and reveals their deepest fears - before crushing them in the dark.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Seize
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Seize</>. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, <debuffred>deafen</>, <debuffred>decay</>, and <debuffred>tether</> enemies.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Haunt</>. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, <debuffred>mark</> and <debuffred>reveal</> enemies in range and line of sight.

abilities.name: Prowler
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Prowler</>. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy or <whitebold>Terror Trail</> it sees, <debuffred>nearsighting</> on impact.

abilities.name: Nightfall
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Nightfall</>. FIRE to send forward a wave that <debuffred>deafens</>, <debuffred>decays</>, and <debuffred>marks</> enemies.

abilities.name: Terror Trails
abilities.description: <debuffred>Marked</> enemies have their location tracked by <whitebold>Terror Trails</>.

name: Gekko
description: Gekko the Angeleno leads a tight-knit crew of calamitous creatures. His buddies bound forward, scattering enemies out of the way, with Gekko chasing them down to regroup and go again.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Wingman
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Wingman</>. FIRE to send it forward. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, <debuffred>concussing</> on impact. ALT FIRE to have <whitebold>Wingman</> plant or defuse at a targeted bomb site.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

abilities.name: Dizzy
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Dizzy</>. FIRE to throw. Fires plasma at enemies in line of sight, <debuffred>blinding</> them.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Mosh</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a zone that deals low <debuffred>damage</> over time before exploding, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Thrash</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, <debuffred>detaining</> all players. FIRE while lunging to explode early.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</> only once.

abilities.name: Globule
abilities.description:
Gekko’s abilities transform into a <whitebold>Globule</> after use.

INTERACT to reclaim nearby <whitebold>Globules</> to gain another charge after a short cooldown.

name: Harbor
description: Hailing from India’s coast, Harbor storms the field wielding ancient technology with dominion over water. He unleashes frothing rapids and crushing waves to shield his allies, or pummel those that oppose him.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: High Tide
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>High Tide</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. ALT FIRE to stop early.

abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Storm Surge</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> all players.

abilities.name: Cove
abilities.description: ENTER The Deep. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view. After casting, REACTIVATE to transform the smoke into a destructible shield.

abilities.name: Reckoning
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Reckoning</>. FIRE to push forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>nearsights</> and <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. REACTIVATE to stop the wall early.

name: Hush
description: Chinese operative Hush uses her telekinesis to close the most classified cases. Fighting with precision and finesse, she redirects her combat utility in midair to disrupt and displace the enemy team before suspending them helplessly for the killing blow.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Flashbulb
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Flashbulb</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

abilities.name: Displacement
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Displacement</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>pulling</> all players towards the center and <debuffred>concussing</> them if they collide with any surface or another player.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Flow
abilities.description: INSTANTLY create an anchor. If Hush is in the air, briefly levitate in place. After a delay, propel towards it.

abilities.name: Suspension
abilities.description: INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Suspension</>. FIRE to send it forward, steering with your crosshair. REACTIVATE or press FIRE again to detonate, <debuffred>levitating</> all players.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description: Hush can pick up weapons, the Spike, and INTERACT with switches from an increased range.

name: Iso
description: Chinese fixer for hire Iso falls into a flow state to dismantle the opposition. Reconfiguring ambient energy into bulletproof protection, he advances with focus towards his next duel to the death.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Undercut
abilities.description: EQUIP an <whitebold>Undercut</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>suppress</> and <debuffred>vulnerable</> to all players.

abilities.name: Kill Contract
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Kill Contract</>. FIRE to send forward a zone that pulls you and the first enemy hit into a duel.

Channel <whitebold>Focus</> at the start of a duel.

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.description: INSTANTLY channel <whitebold>Focus</>. Gain a shield that blocks one instance of damage.

abilities.name: Contingency
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Contingency</>. FIRE to push forward an indestructible vision-blocking wall. ALT FIRE for a slower wall.

abilities.name: Focus
abilities.description:
While <whitebold>Focused</>, reload faster and spawn destructible energy orbs from dead enemies Iso has damaged or killed.

When an energy orb is shot, grant a shield that blocks one instance of damage and refresh <whitebold>Focus</>.

name: Jett
description: Representing her home country of South Korea, Jett's agile and evasive fighting style lets her take risks no one else can. She runs circles around every skirmish, cutting enemies up before they even know what hit them.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.description: INSTANTLY propel high into the air.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY prepare a dash. REACTIVATE to dash forward or in your movement direction.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.description: INSTANTLY throw a cloud. Forms into a brief smoke on any surface or after a delay. HOLD ACTIVATE to steer towards your crosshair.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY access five accurate throwing knives that deal <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the head.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, refresh your knives. ALT FIRE to throw all remaining knives without a refresh.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.description: HOLD JUMP while falling to <teal>glide</>.

name: KAY/O
description: KAY/O is a machine of war built for a single purpose: neutralizing radiants. His power to Suppress enemy abilities dismantles his opponents' capacity to fight back, securing him and his allies the ultimate edge.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: FRAG/ment
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>FRAG/ment</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, repeatedly dealing pulses of <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

abilities.name: FLASH/drive
abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>FLASH/drive</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

abilities.name: ZERO/point
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>ZERO/point</>. FIRE to throw. Pulses on any surface, <debuffred>suppressing</> enemies within range.

abilities.name: NULL/cmd
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY gain <teal>overloaded</> and repeatedly send out a pulse that <debuffred>suppresses</> enemies within range.

<teal>Overloaded</> grants <teal>combat stim</>. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</>, KAY/O is downed and can be re-stabilized.

name: Killjoy
description: The genius of Germany, Killjoy effortlessly secures key battlefield positions with her arsenal of inventions. If their damage doesn't take her enemies out, the debuff her robots provide will make short work of them.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Nanoswarm
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Nanoswarm</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. <whitebold>Nanoswarm</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: ALARMBOT
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Alarmbot</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Alarmbot</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, exploding and applying <debuffred>vulnerable</>.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: TURRET
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Turret</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to flip the direction or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place. Shoots at enemies in line of sight.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Lockdown
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Lockdown</>. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, <debuffred>detain</> enemies within range.

name: Miks
description: Straight from Croatia, Miks takes the stage channeling pure sound energy. With his infectious passion and sonic powers, he rallies his squad to move as one as they set the tempo on the battlefield together.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: M-pulse
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>M-Pulse</>. ALT FIRE to toggle between <debuffred>concuss</> or <teal>heal</>. FIRE to throw. Repeatedly pulses on landing, applying the selected effect on all players within range.

abilities.name: Waveform
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

abilities.name: Harmonize
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Harmonize</>. FIRE on a targeted ally to grant <teal>combat stim</> and <teal>haste</> to them and yourself. On kills while active, refresh the <teal>buff</> if both <whitebold>Harmonized</> players are still alive. ALT FIRE to self-cast with no refresh.

abilities.name: Bassquake
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Bassquake</>. FIRE to send forward a zone that <debuffred>deafens</>, <debuffred>knocks back</>, and <debuffred>slows</> all players.

name: Neon
description: Filipino Agent Neon surges forward at shocking speeds, discharging bursts of bioelectric radiance as fast as her body generates it. She races ahead to catch enemies off guard then strikes them down quicker than lightning.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: High Gear
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume fuel to gain <teal>haste</>. REACTIVATE to cancel. ALT FIRE to slide forward or in your movement direction.

Slide resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Relay Bolt
abilities.description: INSTANTLY throw a bolt that bounces once. Explodes on each surface, <debuffred>concussing</> all players.

abilities.name: Fast Lane
abilities.description: INSTANTLY launch two vision-blocking walls that extend until they hit a surface.

abilities.name: Overdrive
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY refresh <whitebold>High Gear</>. Access an accurate lightning beam that can be used while activating <whitebold>High Gear</>.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, fully recharge fuel.

abilities.name: Battery
abilities.description: Passively recharge fuel over time.

name: Omen
description: A phantom of a memory, Omen hunts in the shadows. He renders enemies blind, teleports across the field, then lets paranoia take hold as his foe scrambles to uncover where he might strike next.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Paranoia
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Paranoia</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>nearsight</> and <debuffred>deafens</> all players.

abilities.name: Dark Cover
abilities.description: ENTER Shadow Vision. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view.

abilities.name: Shrouded Step
abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Shrouded Step</>. FIRE to briefly channel, then teleport to a targeted location.

abilities.name: From the Shadows
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to begin a teleport to a selected location. While teleporting, Omen appears as a destructible shade at the destination. REACTIVATE to cancel.

name: Phoenix
description: Hailing from the U.K., Phoenix's star power shines through in his fighting style, igniting the battlefield with flash and flare. Whether he's got backup or not, he's rushing in to fight on his own terms.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Blaze</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking <whitebold>fire</> wall that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair.

abilities.name: Hot Hands
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Hot Hands</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a <whitebold>fire</> zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

abilities.name: Curveball
abilities.description:
EQUIP a <whitebold>Curveball</>. FIRE to curve left, ALT FIRE to curve right. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Run it Back
abilities.description: INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</> or when <whitebold>Run it Back</> expires, return to the marker with full health and the amount of armor you had when the ability was activated.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.description: Phoenix <teal>heals</> while standing in his own <whitebold>fire</> instead of taking damage.

name: Raze
description: Raze explodes out of Brazil with her big personality and big guns. With her blunt-force-trauma playstyle, she excels at flushing entrenched enemies and clearing tight spaces with a generous dose of "boom."

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Blast Pack
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY throw a destructible <whitebold>Blast Pack</> that sticks to surfaces that fully arms after a delay. REACTIVATE to detonate, <debuffred>knocking away</> anything hit.

If fully armed, <whitebold>Blast Pack</> will also deal <debuffred>damage</> to enemies.

abilities.name: Paint Shells
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Paint Shells</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, dealing <debuffred>damage</> and creating sub-munitions, each also dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Boom Bot
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Boom Bot</>. FIRE to send it forward. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, exploding and dealing <debuffred>damage</> to enemies on impact.

abilities.name: Showstopper
abilities.description: INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Showstopper</>. FIRE to launch. Explodes on any surface, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

name: Reyna
description: Forged in the heart of Mexico, Reyna dominates single combat, popping off with each kill she scores. Her capability is only limited by her raw skill, making her sharply dependent on performance.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to <teal>heal</>. Excess healing is converted into <teal>overheal</>.

While ULTIMATE is active, <whitebold>Devour</> auto-casts.

abilities.name: Dismiss
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to briefly become <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to cancel early.

While ULTIMATE is active, also gain <teal>invisibility</>.

abilities.name: Leer
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Leer</>. FIRE to send. After a delay, form, <debuffred>nearsighting</> enemies looking at it.

abilities.name: Empress
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY gain <teal>Empress</>.

<teal>Empress</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, endless <whitebold>Soul Orb</> consumption, and permanent <teal>overheal</>.

abilities.name: Vitality
abilities.description: Spawn a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> from dead enemies Reyna has damaged or killed.

name: Sage
description: The bastion of China, Sage creates safety for herself and her team wherever she goes. Able to revive fallen friends and stave off forceful assaults, she provides a calm center to a hellish battlefield.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Slow Orb
abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Slow Orb</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players and plays an audio cue when enemies run through it.

abilities.name: Healing Orb
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Healing Orb</>. FIRE on a damaged ally to grant <teal>healing</>. ALT FIRE to self-cast.

abilities.name: Barrier Orb
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Barrier Orb</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to pivot the wall or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place a destructible wall that fortifies after a delay.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Resurrection</>. FIRE on a targeted dead ally to <teal>resurrect</> them.

name: Skye
description: Hailing from Australia, Skye and her band of beasts trailblaze the way through hostile territory. With her creations hampering the enemy, and her power to heal others, the team is strongest and safest by Skye's side.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Trailblazer
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trailblazer</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, <debuffred>concussing</> all players and dealing <debuffred>damage</> to enemies on direct hits.

abilities.name: Guiding Light
abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Guiding Light</>. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. REACTIVATE to detonate, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Regrowth</>. HOLD FIRE to <teal>heal</> allies in range and line of sight. Uses a limited healing pool.

Cannot heal self.

abilities.name: Seekers
abilities.description: EQUIP destructible <whitebold>Seekers</>. FIRE to send out up to three <whitebold>Seekers</>. <debuffred>Chases</> the three closest enemies, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> on impact.

name: Sova
description: Born from the eternal winter of Russia's tundra, Sova tracks, finds, and eliminates enemies with ruthless efficiency and precision. His custom bow and incredible scouting abilities ensure that even if you run, you cannot hide.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Shock Bolt
abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Shock Bolt</>. FIRE to shoot a bolt that explodes on any surface, dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

abilities.name: Recon Bolt
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Recon Bolt</>. FIRE to shoot a bolt that repeatedly <debuffred>reveals</> nearby enemies in range and line of sight. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

abilities.name: Owl Drone
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Owl Drone</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to shoot a dart that repeatedly <debuffred>reveals</> enemies.

abilities.name: Hunter's Fury
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Hunter’s Fury</>. FIRE to shoot a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</>. Can be fired up to two more times.

Enemies hit are <debuffred>revealed</> to Sova.

name: Tejo
description: A veteran intelligence consultant from Colombia, Tejo’s ballistic guidance system pressures the enemy to relinquish their ground - or their lives. His targeted strikes keep opponents off balance and under his heel.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Guided Salvo
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set locations. ALT FIRE to launch missiles that travel to and repeatedly pulse, dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

abilities.name: Special Delivery
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Special Delivery</>. FIRE to launch. ALT FIRE to launch with a bounce. Explodes on any surface, <debuffred>concussing</> and <debuffred>damaging</> all players.

abilities.name: Armageddon
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to cast a wave that deals high <debuffred>damage</> to all players. ALT FIRE to cancel targeting.

abilities.name: Stealth Drone
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Stealth Drone</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to <debuffred>reveal</> and <debuffred>suppress</> nearby enemies in range and line of sight.

name: Veto
description: Empowered by an unstoppable DNA mutation, Senegalese enforcer Veto defies the rules of engagement by nullifying his opponent's powers and technology. On Veto's battlefield, gunplay is your only guarantee.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Interceptor
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Interceptor</>. FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to activate. While active, destroy any enemy utility that can be shot or would bounce off players in range and line of sight.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Crosscut
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Crosscut</>. FIRE to place. While in range, INTERACT to teleport to it.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Evolution
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY gain <teal>evolution</>.

<teal>Evolution</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, continuous <teal>healing</>, and <teal>immunity</> to all debuffs and damage, except weapons.

abilities.name: Chokehold
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Chokehold</>. FIRE to throw. <whitebold>Chokehold</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, <debuffred>deafening</>, <debuffred>decaying</>, and <debuffred>tethering</> enemies.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

name: Viper
description: The American Chemist, Viper deploys an array of poisonous chemical devices to control the battlefield and choke the enemy's vision. If the toxins don't kill her prey, her mindgames surely will.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Poison Cloud
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Poison Cloud</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> smoke that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Toxic Screen
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Toxic Screen</>. FIRE to send forward and place a line of emitters. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.

abilities.name: Snake Bite
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Snake Bite</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that grants <debuffred>vulnerable</> and deals low <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

abilities.name: Viper's Pit
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Viper’s Pit</>. FIRE to form a large <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking cloud that <debuffred>decays</> enemies inside.

HOLD ACTIVATE to cancel the cloud.

abilities.name: Toxin
abilities.description: Viper’s <whitebold>Toxin</> continuously inflicts <debuffred>decay</> when enemies come in contact. Passively recharge fuel over time.

name: Vyse
description: Metallic mastermind Vyse unleashes liquid metal to isolate, trap, and disarm her enemies. Through cunning and manipulation, she forces all who oppose her to fear the battlefield itself.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Shear
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Shear</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Shear</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers when enemies walk on it, and after a delay, create a brief indestructible wall.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Arc Rose
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Arc Rose</>. FIRE to place. ALT FIRE to place it through a wall. REACTIVATE to <debuffred>flash</> all players looking at it. 

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Razorvine
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Razorvine</>. FIRE to throw. <whitebold>Razorvine</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> and deals <debuffred>damage</> when players move through it.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Steel Garden
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Steel Garden</>. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, <debuffred>jam</> enemy primary weapons within range.

name: Waylay
description: Thailand's prismatic radiant Waylay transforms into light itself as she darts across the battlefield, striking down her targets through shards of light before flitting back to safety, all in the blink of an eye.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Refract
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. REACTIVATE to travel to it. While traveling, Waylay is <teal>immune</> but cannot see enemies.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Saturate
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Saturate</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>hindering</> all players.

abilities.name: Lightspeed
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Lightspeed</>. FIRE to dash forward twice. ALT FIRE to dash forward once.

Only the first dash can launch upward.

abilities.name: Convergent Paths
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Convergent Paths</>. FIRE to gain <teal>haste</> and send forward a zone that <debuffred>hinders</> all players.

name: Yoru
description: Japanese native Yoru rips holes straight through reality to infiltrate enemy lines unseen. Using deception and aggression in equal measure, he gets the drop on each target before they know where to look.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: FAKEOUT
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Fakeout</>. FIRE to send a destructible clone forward. ALT FIRE to place a marker at your location. INTERACT to transform the marker into a clone.

Clones continuously walk forward and will turn toward the first enemy that shoots it, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

abilities.name: BLINDSIDE
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Blindside</>. FIRE to throw. After bouncing off a surface, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

abilities.name: GATECRASH
abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Gatecrash</>. FIRE to send it forward. ALT FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to teleport to it. INTERACT to fake a teleport.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: DIMENSIONAL DRIFT
abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Dimensional Drift</>. FIRE to become <teal>intangible</> and <teal>invisible</>. <whitebold>Gatecrash</> is accessible during this state. REACTIVATE to exit early.
